title: Numbers
description: Counting, comparing, and adding within ten.

levels.title: Numbers 1 and 2
levels.lessonText: One apple. Two apples. Count each group out loud.
levels.prompt: How many stars do you see if there is one star and one more?

levels.title: Numbers 3 and 4
levels.lessonText: Three mangoes. Four bananas. Point to each one as you count.

levels.title: Numbers 5 and 6
levels.lessonText: Five fingers on one hand. Six eggs in a tray.
levels.prompt: How many fingers are on one hand?

levels.title: Numbers 7 and 8
levels.lessonText: Seven days in a week. Eight legs on a spider.
levels.prompt: How many legs does a spider have?

levels.title: Numbers 9 and 10
levels.lessonText: Nine stars, then ten. Ten is two hands of five.

levels.title: Count and Drop: 1 to 3
levels.lessonText: Drag the right number of fruits into the basket.
levels.prompt: The basket has two fruits. Which number matches?

levels.title: Count and Drop: 4 to 6
levels.lessonText: Count the items, then choose the matching number.
levels.prompt: There are five balloons. Which number matches?

levels.title: Count and Drop: 7 to 10
levels.lessonText: Larger groups need careful counting. Tap each item once.
levels.prompt: There are eight fish. Which number matches?

levels.title: More or Fewer: Small Groups
levels.lessonText: Compare two groups. Which one has more?
levels.prompt: Three apples or five apples. Which group has more?

levels.title: More or Fewer: Bigger Groups
levels.lessonText: Count both groups, then compare the numbers.
levels.prompt: Eight stars or six stars. Which group has fewer?

levels.title: Add Within 10
levels.prompt: Two birds join three birds. How many birds in all?

levels.title: Take Away Within 10
levels.lessonText: Taking away means removing from a group. 5 - 2 = 3.
levels.prompt: Five cookies, two are eaten. How many are left?

levels.title: Numbers Celebration
levels.lessonText: Wonderful counting! Let's review everything you learned.
levels.prompt: Four cats plus four cats. How many cats in all?
